iSekur for Windows
==================

A Cygwin build of iSekur with everything it needs in this folder: no installer, nothing
to install, no Cygwin required. It is new and less tried than the macOS and Linux
packages: please report what doesn't work on https://github.com/gcanosa/iSekur/issues

Run
---
Open Windows Terminal (or cmd, or PowerShell) and run isekur.cmd from this folder:

    .\isekur.cmd

Try Windows Terminal first. Put this folder
anywhere (add it to your PATH to type just "isekur.cmd"). Your settings, logs and
plugins are kept in your profile, in %USERPROFILE%\.config\isekur, so replacing this
folder with a newer one keeps them.

To add a network: "/server irc.sekurnet.org 6697 -tls -name sekurnet", then
"/join #iSekur". "/help" lists everything; the README.md here and
https://gcanosa.github.io/isekur-site/ have the rest, including the built-in webchat
("/web start" after setting [web] user and password_hash) that you can open in any browser.

What this build doesn't have
----------------------------
Cygwin has no PAM and its unix sockets can't pass a terminal, so:
  - no /shell
  - no detach and attach (Alt+D, /detach, --daemon, --attach)

For all of iSekur on Windows, use WSL ("wsl --install" in an administrator terminal),
and inside it the Linux package from the same release page (isekur-linux-x86_64.tar.gz).

Windows may say it protected your PC the first time (the program isn't signed): "More
info", then "Run anyway".

iSekur is free software, GPL-3.0-or-later: see LICENSE.
